ready_attachment_verified.name: ready_attachment_verified
ready_attachment_verified.value: "attachments"."state" <> 'ready' OR ("attachments"."object_key" IS NOT NULL AND "attachments"."object_version" IS NOT NULL AND "attachments"."mime" IS NOT NULL AND "attachments"."bytes" IS NOT NULL AND "attachments"."width" IS NOT NULL AND "attachments"."height" IS NOT NULL AND "attachments"."sha256" IS NOT NULL AND "attachments"."mime" IN ('image/jpeg','image/png','image/webp') AND "attachments"."bytes" > 0 AND "attachments"."bytes" <= 20971520 AND "attachments"."width" > 0 AND "attachments"."height" > 0 AND "attachments"."width"::bigint * "attachments"."height"::bigint <= 40000000 AND "attachments"."sha256" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$')

bookmark_url_required.name: bookmark_url_required
bookmark_url_required.value: "bookmarks"."kind"::text IN ('image', 'text', 'stash') OR ("bookmarks"."url" IS NOT NULL AND "bookmarks"."canonical_url" IS NOT NULL)

bookmark_url_safe.name: bookmark_url_safe
bookmark_url_safe.value: ("bookmarks"."url" IS NULL OR (char_length("bookmarks"."url") <= 8192 AND "bookmarks"."url" ~* '^https?://[^/?#@[:space:]]+([/?#]|$)')) AND ("bookmarks"."canonical_url" IS NULL OR (char_length("bookmarks"."canonical_url") <= 8192 AND "bookmarks"."canonical_url" ~* '^https?://[^/?#@[:space:]]+([/?#]|$)'))

entity_purge_requires_trash.name: entity_purge_requires_trash

person_avatar_valid.name: person_avatar_valid
person_avatar_valid.value:
char_length("person_avatars"."handle") BETWEEN 3 AND 80 AND "person_avatars"."handle" ~ '^(x|github|youtube|codeforces|bilibili):[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,64}$' AND (
				("person_avatars"."state" = 'missing' AND "person_avatars"."object_key" IS NULL) OR
				("person_avatars"."state" = 'stored' AND "person_avatars"."object_key" IS NOT NULL AND "person_avatars"."mime" IN ('image/jpeg','image/png','image/webp')
					AND "person_avatars"."bytes" > 0 AND "person_avatars"."bytes" <= 2097152 AND "person_avatars"."sha256" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$')
			)
